notes: *and* is `added`: no conjunction morpheme stands between the two adjectives (rule 14's closing sentence).
The copula was given to the fronted predicate לֵץ rather than to the subject שְׁמוֹ, as rule 20 directs where a predicate morpheme is present.
The supplied generic *man* was attached to יָהִיר, the substantive it stands beside; attaching it to זֵד instead was the competing reading (rules 31 and 46).
